rules.readout_name_exact: Mean Ribosome Load (MRL) in Synthetic 5'UTR MPRA & Within-Gene Centered Polysome MRL (TrIP-seq)
rules.statement: Upstream AUG (uAUG) motifs in the 5'UTR correlate negatively with translation across two distinct CC-BY-4.0 datasets: (1) Seelig Lab UW (Castillo-Hair et al. 2024 Nat Commun, GSE232927, HEK293T synthetic 50-nt 5'UTR MPRA, N=25,000: Spearman rho=-0.5821, 95% CI [-0.5945, -0.5754]); and (2) Doudna Lab UC Berkeley (Floor & Doudna 2016 eLife 10921, PMC4764583, floor_doudna_elife10921_tripseq_isoforms_v1.parquet SHA-256 prefix 2590b50dad0dcfd1, 50,739 mapped isoforms across 11,928 multi-isoform genes; RiboNN external-eval overlap disclosed): retrospective descriptive correlation between uncentered 5'UTR uAUG count and within-gene centered MRL is rho=-0.1055 (separate uORF count rho=-0.10083). HELD AT conditional_rule (A-W11 remediation) pending gene-cluster bootstrap uncertainty over within-gene centered uAUG features and an independently dated pre-analysis specification. Cao 2021 (GSE176581) pre-filtered 5'UTRs to 0 uAUGs and contributes 0 votes.

audit_history.reason: Direct Colab empirical verification on strictly commercial-clean public GEO/CC-BY-4.0 datasets (deduplicated by underlying_dataset_id).

Wave 10/11 independent concordant negative replication confirmed on Floor & Doudna 2016 eLife 10921 CC-BY-4.0 endogenous HEK293T TrIP-seq (50,739 isoforms / 11,928 multi-isoform genes; within-gene centered MRL uAUG rho=-0.1055, uORF rho=-0.10083). Cao 2021 honestly excluded (0 uAUGs by design); RiboNN benchmark overlap disclosed.

A-W11 Important finding remediation: held at conditional_rule because Floor-Doudna analysis was retrospective without a dated preregistration and paired uncentered uAUG with isoform-pooled within-gene centered MRL; retain descriptive association pending gene-cluster uncertainty.

rules.statement: Purine (A/G) at position -3 relative to canonical AUG boosts 5'UTR translation initiation (GSE232927 N=25000: rho=0.2178, p=4.344e-266, 95% CI [0.206, 0.2327]; Cao2021 GSE176581 Top-2.5% rho=0.0028).

audit_history.reason: Verified on GSE232927 paired HEK293T MRL; kept conditional pending m1Psi CC-BY-4.0 replication.

rules.readout_name_exact: mRNA Stability Slope (decay_rate in Wu 2019 eLife 45396)
rules.statement: Higher human CDS GC3 and CAI correlate with greater endogenous mRNA stability across HEK293T (CAI rho=0.1042, N=13079, p=6.763e-33) and K562 SLAM-seq (GC3 rho=0.1346, N=8789, p=8.211e-37). Caveat: endogenous spliced mRNAs; do not blindly extrapolate magnitude to intronless m1Psi IVT mRNA without wet-lab calibration.

model_interpretations.summary: Wave 10 RC-005 (Apache-2.0/Apache-2.0/CC-BY-4.0, Homo sapiens id=59) zero-shot synonymous log-likelihood exceeds classical CAI magnitude across all 4 Wu 2019 human cell lines (13,568 scored CDSs: 293T +0.1514 vs +0.1042, K562 +0.1676 vs +0.1175, HeLa -0.1898 vs -0.1701, RPE -0.1873 vs -0.1485) and Leppek 2022 CDS24 6h/24h expression (+0.5052/+0.4365 vs +0.0191/+0.1930).

audit_history.reason: Verified on Wu 2019 CC-BY-4.0 mapped to GENCODE v49 across HEK293T and K562; single underlying study so capped at conditional_rule.

rules.readout_name_exact: Endogenous Decay Slope (Wu 2019 eLife) & Direct Upstream Siegel 2022 G3 fastUTR T4/T0 GC-resid + Causal 1-ARE Deletion
rules.statement: AU-rich element (ARE, AUUUA) count in the 3'UTR consistently reduces human mRNA stability across TWO independent CC-BY-4.0 labs and assay modalities with zero sample overlap: (1) Wu et al. 2019 eLife 45396 (PMC6529216, CC BY 4.0) + GENCODE v49 endogenous HEK293T (N=13,079, rho=-0.1911, p=8.08e-108); AND (2) Direct upstream Siegel et al. 2022 G3 (doi:10.1093/g3journal/jkab404, PMC8728028, CC BY 4.0; GitHub david-a-siegel/AU-Rich-Elements SHA-256 39b8cd5fad482e3d / 4b3e1b3452a7753d) synthetic 160-nt 3'UTR fastUTR MPRA: Beas2B T4/T0 GC-resid (N=7,613, rho=-0.1831, p=2.18e-58; causal 1-ARE deletion N=226, 74.8% stabilized, p=4.76e-17) & Jurkat T4/T0 GC-resid (N=30,253, rho=-0.1918, p=1.98e-248; causal 1-ARE deletion N=2,242, 68.1% stabilized, p=1.35e-97).

audit_history.reason: Verified on Wu 2019 CC-BY-4.0 + GENCODE v49; supports CellExpressionController 3'UTR ARE avoidance.
Independent concordant negative replication confirmed on Siegel 2022 fastUTR 3'UTR MPRA (Beas2B + Jurkat, N=27,550, rho=-0.0934, p=2.178e-54).

C-W6 independent audit remediation: fixed Siegel 2022 (PMC8728028) vs Rabani 2017 (PMC5996376) citation conflation; conservatively held at conditional_rule until direct upstream Siegel 2022 file hash and observation-level non-overlap manifest are attached.

Closed C-W6 audit gap: verified direct upstream Siegel et al. 2022 G3 (PMC8728028, CC BY 4.0) GitHub CSVs with exact SHA-256 hashes and confirmed both T4/T0 GC-resid Spearman (-0.183/-0.192) and deliberate causal single-ARE deletion stabilization (74.8% Beas2B, 68.1% Jurkat, p=1.35e-97). Zero sample overlap with Wu 2019 endogenous HEK293T.

rules.readout_name_exact: In-solution hydrolysis half-life (hours) vs In-cell half-life (PERSIST-seq)
rules.statement: In-solution mRNA hydrolysis half-life shows no statistically significant positive rank correlation with in-cell half-life across paired constructs (Leppek 2022 GSE173083 Table S1 N=191: Spearman rho=-0.1243, p=0.08663), cautioning against treating in-vitro buffer chemical stability as a sufficient proxy for in-cell persistence; optimization should evaluate shelf hydrolysis and cellular half-life on separate Pareto axes.

model_interpretations.summary: BSD-3-Clause EternaFold predicted average unpaired probability (author_aup_eternafold in Leppek 2022 CC-BY-4.0 Table S5, N=24) strongly anticorrelates with measured in-solution hydrolysis half-life (Spearman rho=-0.7635, p=1.424e-05); recorded strictly in model_interpretations separate from wet-lab half-life decoupling.

Wave 10 RC-004 live C++11 build (commit 702d3e48, ldd verified 0 ViennaRNA/GPL) reproduced Leppek 2022 author_aup_eternafold at Pearson r=0.99987 (MAE=0.00574) and in-solution half-life Spearman rho=-0.76174 (p=1.53e-5, n=24).

audit_history.reason: Verified on Leppek 2022 CC-BY-4.0 PERSIST-seq; explicitly captures in-solution vs in-cell decoupling.

rules.statement: Substituting m1Psi (mpU) for unmodified U across 39 identical synonymous firefly luciferase (fLuc) CDS constructs (Mauger 2019 PNAS GSE139176) shifts median SHAPE-MaP reactivity lower (per-construct median U=0.3605 vs mpU=0.3363; pooled-nt median U=0.3572 vs mpU=0.3324) and breaks construct-level mean reactivity rank concordance (Spearman mpU vs U = -0.0686, N=39 paired constructs). Unmodified-U structure rankings must NOT be extrapolated directly to m1Psi constructs without chemistry-specific parameters or probes.

model_interpretations.summary: MIT structRFM per-nt probe achieves OOD Spearman 0.5858 on U and 0.5918 when trained natively on m1Psi (mpU), whereas applying the U-trained probe zero-shot to m1Psi drops to 0.5124.

Wave 10 RC-004 chemistry-agnostic EternaFold v1.3.1 (w500) beats ViennaRNA zero-shot on all 3 Mauger 2019 chemistries (U=0.52374 vs 0.4517, 5moU=0.49499 vs 0.4098, m1Psi=0.42449 vs 0.4142), yet degrades by -0.099 on m1Psi vs U — confirming m1Psi per-nt structure must route to supervised structRFM (0.5918) or Orthrus 6-track (0.5714).

audit_history.reason: Directly measured across all 117 Mauger 2019 Moderna CC-BY-4.0 SHAPE-MaP files (39 paired constructs x 3 chemistries).

rules.readout_name_exact: Mean Ribosome Load (MRL) / Top-2.5% GFP Bin Enrichment / Endogenous TE
rules.statement: High GC content in the 15 nt immediately upstream of the canonical AUG start codon (gc_tail15) consistently reduces translation across TWO independent strictly commercial-clean CC-BY-4.0 labs and synthetic 5'UTR MPRA screens: (1) Castillo-Hair et al. 2024 GSE232927 (Seelig Lab UW, HEK293T MRL MPRA, N=25,000: rho=-0.0550, p=3.15e-18); AND (2) Cao et al. 2021 GSE176581 (Lu Lab MIT, HEK293T Top-2.5% GFP MPRA after 5'/3' adapter stripping, N=4,000: rho=-0.0482, p=2.28e-3). (Note: Cao et al.'s endogenous TE comparison rho=-0.0986 originates from separate external ribosome-profiling accessions and is NOT counted under GSE176581.)

audit_history.reason: Independent concordant negative direction confirmed across two distinct labs and underlying datasets (GSE232927 + GSE176581).

A-W11 Important finding remediation: aligned CC-MRNAX-M15-CAO2021-GCTIS ledger effect to the exact GSE176581 Top-2.5% GFP MPRA endpoint (rho=-0.0482, p=2.28e-3, N=4,000) rather than external endogenous TE accessions.

rules.readout_name_exact: Saluki Cross-Study PC1 mRNA Half-Life (Human vs Mouse 1:1 Orthologs)
rules.statement: Intrinsic endogenous mammalian mRNA half-life ranks are strongly conserved between human and mouse across 10,955 1:1 ortholog pairs (Saluki Agarwal & Kelley 2022 Apache-2.0/CC-BY-4.0: Spearman rho=0.7643, Pearson r=0.7754, p<1e-300). Supports mouse preclinical stability ranking as a directional prior for human constructs, while still requiring wet-lab m1Psi/LNP validation for therapeutic translation.

audit_history.reason: Verified on 10,955 Saluki human<->mouse 1:1 ortholog pairs (Apache-2.0/CC-BY-4.0). Capped at conditional_rule because meta-analysis derives from single curated Saluki consortium table and measures endogenous unmodified transcripts.

rules.readout_name_exact: Cross-Platform Vaccine +1FS T-Cell ELISpot (Mulroney 2024 Fig 2b) & HEK293T Dual-Fluorescence Recoding Ratio Across 6 Spike Sites (Poulis & Rodnina 2026 Fig 1e/4e/4h)
rules.statement: BIOLOGICAL OBSERVATION (DEMOTED TO conditional_rule per A-W11 C5 pending matched-chemistry re-adjudication): Two independent CC-BY-4.0 labs report m1Psi-associated +1 ribosomal frameshifting/recoding at uridine-rich slippery motifs (zero double-counting of G-W9 s41467-026-77796-3, which IS Poulis & Rodnina 2026): (1) Mulroney et al. 2024 Nature (PMC10764286, Fig 2b n=8/group): mouse T-cell +1FS ELISpot after BNT162b2 m1Psi-mRNA (mean 249.06 SFU/10^6) vs ChAdOx1 adenoviral vector (mean 19.06) vs untreated (5.0) — note Fig 2b is a cross-platform vaccine immune readout, NOT a matched U-IVT vs m1Psi-IVT chemistry comparison (re-adjudication must extract Mulroney's matched Fig 1 reporter data); AND (2) Poulis, Rodnina et al. 2026 Nat Commun (PMC13620113, PMID:42805987, m1psi_poulis_rodnina2026_recoding_ccby4_v1.parquet SHA-256 518d441b2ffb48c4485e1f150276abc5ef6c1a2d911468ff4c7cb5915b70687a): Fig 1e HEK293T dual-fluorescence reporter (NOT reconstituted translation) m1Psi/U mean ratios across ALL 6 tested Spike sites are 0.842 (U3319-C3322, opposite direction), 1.080 (U3178-U3181), 1.484 (U766-C769), 1.606 (U1543-C1546), 1.671 (U1981-C1984), and 3.162 (U3238-C3241) vs background 0.410; Fig 4h 1st-codon-position C vs U Mann-Whitney p=5.04e-4 (1.4439 vs 0.9430, n=10 vs 10); Fig 4e BNT162b2 UUCC replacement ratio=1.048x. SEPARATE OPERATIONAL POLICY: Independently of verified biological-rule adjudication, mRNAx retains conservative deterministic synonymous avoidance of UUUC and U{4,} runs in m1Psi CDS designs as an engineering safety heuristic (preferring synonymous UUCC where valid).

audit_history.reason: Direct source-data verification across two completely independent CC-BY-4.0 author lineages (Willis lab Cambridge Nature 2024 + Rodnina lab MPI Goettingen Nat Commun 2026) on native m1Psi chemistry.

Wave 11 ingested full Poulis & Rodnina 2026 Source Data Parquet (SHA-256 518d441b2ffb48c4), confirming UUUC->UUCC abolition (Fig 4e/4h p=5.04e-4) while preserving exact 2-independent-lab count (no double-counting of G-W9).

A-W11 Critical Finding C5 remediation: withdrawn from verified_rule pending matched-chemistry re-adjudication (Mulroney Fig 2b compares BNT162b2 vs ChAdOx1 platforms rather than matched U vs m1Psi IVT; Poulis Fig 1e is HEK293T dual-fluorescence across 6 sites [0.842..3.162] with 1 site opposite). Operational safety heuristic cleanly separated.

rules.readout_name_exact: Human Codon Stabilization Coefficient (CSC) & 61x61 Bicodon Stability Enrichment (N=13,642 genes)
rules.statement: Across 13,642 human GENCODE v49 canonical CDS mapped to Saluki 39-study PC1 half-life (CC-BY-4.0 / Apache-2.0), individual codons and adjacent bicodon pairs show strong stability stratification: top stabilizing codons AUC (Ile, CSC=+0.1796), GUG (Val, +0.1736), GUC (Val, +0.1445) vs destabilizing AGU (Ser, -0.1719), CAU (His, -0.1667), UCA (Ser, -0.1619), UGU (Cys, -0.1608); and destabilizing bicodons such as CAU-ACU (-3.66 log2) and GAA-UGU (-3.38 log2). Caveat: endogenous unmodified human mRNAs; combine with m1Psi slippery-run remediation and wet-lab validation.

audit_history.reason: Computed directly across all 13,642 human genes in Saluki consensus half-life + GENCODE v49; exported as human_codon_bicodon_stability_atlas_v1.json.

rules.readout_name_exact: Model-Benchmark Evidence: Per-Nucleotide EternaFold v1.3.1 Unpaired Probability Calibration vs Chemical Probing Reactivity
rules.statement: MODEL-BENCHMARK CALIBRATION EVIDENCE (DEMOTED FROM verified_rule TO conditional_rule per A-W11 C4 — NOT a raw biological rule): Per-nucleotide unpaired probabilities from one model (EternaFold v1.3.1, currently HELD AT commercial_clearance_pending per A-W11 C3) correlate positively with unmodified-U nucleotide-level chemical probing reactivity across three datasets, with explicit unit & overlap bounds: (1) Mauger 2019 (GSE139176, 39 x 1,815-nt fLuc mRNAs / 68,531 U nt): pooled per-nt rho=+0.52374 (per-construct median 0.52539), HOWEVER construct-level mean AUP vs mean SHAPE is null (rho=0.03462, p=0.8343, n=39) and EternaBench lists 38 Mauger constructs (historical overlap audit pending); (2) Huang / Ling-Ling Chen Lab 2026 (PMC13092624, circrna_cellres2026_ires_cargo_v1.parquet SHA-256 prefix 3ec2f6d9e2308296): 9 physical constructs represent only 5 unique scored SV-A IRES sequences (scored without cargo; pooled 6,053-nt rho=+0.42677, construct median 0.42839; nucleotide-pooled p does not measure construct-level uncertainty); (3) RMDB OK7BLIB_2A3_0000 (PMID:42239184, rmdb_ok7blib_2a3_cc0_v1.parquet SHA-256 prefix 62eed84fcd79a2b9, Das Lab — EternaFold developer lineage): 4,932 constructs / 1,178,519 valid nt, global rho=+0.54112, group_key-pooled mean rho=+0.52229 across 3,701 group_key strings (3,568 singletons; only 20 distinct nonempty target structures, 784 missing target_structure). ETERNA_R69_0000 (rho=0.65883) excluded from OOD claims.

model_interpretations.summary: Frozen zero-shot per-nt p_unpaired benchmarked against Mauger 2019 U SHAPE-MaP (per-nt rho=0.52374; construct mean rho=0.03462 p=0.8343), Huang 2026 SV-A IRES SHAPE (5 unique IRES seqs / 9 constructs, per-nt rho=0.42677), and OK7BLIB_2A3 (4,932 constructs / 20 nonempty target structures, global rho=0.54112). Held inactive pending S-Processed training-data rights clearance (A-W11 C3); outputs strictly separate from mfe_kcal_mol.

audit_history.reason: Wave 10/11 empirical shootout verified positive per-nucleotide unpaired-probability vs wet-lab SHAPE/2A3 reactivity concordance across 3 independent CC0/CC-BY-4.0 labs (Moderna Mauger 2019 + CAS Ling-Ling Chen 2026 + Stanford OpenKnot OK7BLIB_2A3), excluding pre-2022 ETERNA_R69 and duplicate-lineage Leppek 2022 from OOD vote count.

A-W11 Critical Finding C4 remediation: withdrawn from verified_rule and reclassified as conditional model-benchmark calibration evidence (model outputs belong in model_interpretations; fixed construct-level vs nt-pooled units, EternaBench 38-construct Mauger overlap, 5 unique SV-A IRES seqs, and OK7BLIB singleton/target-structure counts).

rules.readout_name_exact: Zero-Shot Synonymous Log-Likelihood Rank vs Expression/Stability & m1Psi Slippery-Run Emission Audit
rules.statement: Apache-2.0/CC-BY-4.0 CodonTransformer v1.0 (Homo sapiens id=59, RC-005) outperforms classical human CAI in zero-shot synonymous ranking on Leppek 2022 CDS24 cellular expression (6h rho=+0.5052, p=0.0118; 24h +0.4365 vs CAI +0.0191/+0.1930), PERSIST-233 ribosome load (+0.1582) & in-cell half-life (+0.1701), and all 4 Wu 2019 cell lines (|rho|=0.151-0.190), with 100% exact AA identity across eGFP/FLuc/NLuc. HOWEVER, it does NOT optimize in-solution hydrolysis (Leppek24 rho=-0.2765) and emits m1Psi-slippery poly-U runs on long ORFs (1 UUUU on FLuc 550aa deterministic; up to 2 UUUU + 1 UUUUU at T=0.2). Operational requirement: ALWAYS pair CodonTransformer proposals with deterministic m1Psi slippery-motif elimination (UUUC and U{4,}) and cleared commercial_clean structure/stability reranking (CommercialCleanSurrogateV2 / structRFM / Orthrus; note EternaFold v1.3.1 RC-004 remains held at commercial_clearance_pending).

model_interpretations.summary: HF revision 9744dcc920d8 (model.safetensors SHA-256 23994e1e..., Apache-2.0/Apache-2.0/CC-BY-4.0): 2.565 GB L4 VRAM, 101.05 seq/s, 0.0 drift.

audit_history.reason: Wave 10 Exp 2 operational shootout finding; kept strictly conditional_rule.

rules.readout_name_exact: Descriptive Surrogate Score Spread Across 8 Prose-Grouped HeLa Non-Significant Dual-UTR Pairs (PMC12355064)
rules.statement: On the Medjmedj et al. 2025 CC-BY-4.0 full-factorial 3x3=9 dual-UTR benchmark (PMC12355064, pmc12355064_utr_pair_factorial_v1.parquet SHA-256 prefix 16544b1ab0386965), ALL 8 non-reference pairs are marked ANOVA non-significant ('ns') versus hAg-AES in HeLa (including UTR4-SOD; the study supplies neither an equivalence margin nor a formal equivalence test). Across the 8 prose-grouped HeLa non-significant pairs (hAg-AES reference + 7 pairs, excluding UTR4-SOD based on prose), unmodified-U commercial-clean surrogates exhibit descriptive score spreads of 0.9083 (utr5_mrl_pred), 0.1662 (utr3_stability_pred), 1.2962 (saluki_nluc), and 2.1510 (saluki_fluc), and Saluki ranks UTR3-AES #1 on FLuc despite its 10-fold in-vivo CDS-switch drop. Treat these ranges as descriptive sensitivity cautions, NOT a formally calibrated equivalence threshold.

model_interpretations.summary: Read-only WO2024231621 Tableau 1 UTR evaluation measured descriptive score spreads of pure-sequence LightGBM heads across 8 prose-grouped HeLa ANOVA non-significant pairs (descriptive sensitivity caution only, NOT an equivalence test or calibrated threshold; UTR pairs screened by sequence FTO).

audit_history.reason: Wave 10 Exp 3A single-lab empirical falsification warning; kept strictly conditional_rule.

rules.readout_name_exact: UTR Reference-vs-Variant Half-Life log2FC Cross-Cell Concordance & Gene-Grouped OOD CV (Su 2025 eLife 97682)
rules.statement: Across 5,072 HGMD-stripped UTR reference/variant stability pairs on fixed EGFP in Su et al. 2025 eLife 97682 (PMC11835390, CC-BY-4.0, su2025_elife97682_utr_variants_v1.parquet SHA-256 4c956ac99399c86e, 100% hg38 ref match), empirical cross-cell transfer between HEK293T and SH-SY5Y is very low (n=2,335 paired: Spearman rho=0.07856, p=1.45e-4, 53.96% same direction). Both zero-shot commercial surrogates (rho=-0.038 to +0.035) and strict gene_symbol-grouped 5-fold OOD LightGBM/Ridge probes failed the >=0.25 deployment gate (HEK293T=-0.0364, SH-SY5Y=-0.0176; 0 weak joblibs deployed). Single-nucleotide UTR variant delta predictions MUST NOT be assumed transferable across cell types without target-cell wet-lab screening.

audit_history.reason: Wave 10 Exp 3B single-lab empirical negative/cautionary finding; kept strictly conditional_rule.

rules.readout_name_exact: Arrayed RBP Tethering Luciferase log2FC on Circular vs Linear Reporter mRNA (Yeo Lab NSMB 2026)
rules.statement: Across 846 RBP isoforms (734 unique gene symbols; 625 significant at FDR<0.05: 577 activators, 48 repressors) in Yu et al. 2026 Nat Struct Mol Biol (Gene Yeo Lab, PMC13759317, CC-BY-4.0, circrna_nsmb2026_rbp_tethering_v1.parquet SHA-256 0d3f01b50af2b626), RBP tethering effects on circRNA translation are highly reproducible between HeLa and HEK293T (secondary n=77 rho=0.86661, p=2.4e-24; exocircFirefly n=48 rho=0.81513) yet diverge strongly from linear mRNA tethering (circ vs linear Luo screen n=748 rho=0.22913). Top circRNA-preferential activators include DDX52 (+2.70 log2FC), DDX19A (+2.05), ANXA2 (+1.92); top repressors include TOB2 (-2.52), CNOT7 (-2.21), RBM15 (-2.02). Single lab -> kept strictly conditional_rule for circRNA RBP-motif steering.

audit_history.reason: Wave 10 Exp 3D single-lab circRNA RBP finding (strictly stratified by source_lab); kept conditional_rule.

rules.readout_name_exact: circRNA IRES & Structural Element Translation Output Across Human Cell Lines (Chen 2023 Nat Biotechnol)
rules.statement: Across 381 quantitative circRNA engineering assays (161 sequence-joined) in Chen et al. 2023 Nat Biotechnol (Howard Chang Lab, PMC9931579, CC-BY-4.0, circrna_chen2023_engineering_v1.parquet SHA-256 240e36e072d158e4), viral IRES translation rank (Fig 5a, n=39) is strongly conserved across HEK293T, HeLa, and HepG2 (rho=0.737-0.890, p<1e-7). Global GC, length, and EternaFold AUP alone do not significantly predict IRES output (p>0.31), whereas specific local structural elements (Fig 3d predicted MFE rho=0.833, p=0.0053; hairpin dG rho=0.800, p=0.0096, n=9) and 3' AU-rich elements (HeLa Fig 5a n_are rho=-0.319, p=0.055) modulate output. Independence caveat: upstream GSE178718 (related earlier Chang Lab screen) overlaps structRFM IRES data per A-W8; an explicit sequence/construct intersection is required before claiming any Chen 2023 subset is unseen by structRFM; kept strictly conditional_rule (single lab).

audit_history.reason: Wave 10 Exp 3D single-lab circRNA IRES/hairpin/ARE finding with explicit GSE178718 overlap disclosure; kept conditional_rule.

rules.readout_name_exact: Single-Read Nanopore Poly(A) Tail Length (nt) & Internal Non-Adenosine (C/G/U) Composition Rate
rules.statement: Poly(A) tail length and non-adenosine (G/C/U) decoration are dynamic, process-sensitive design variables across two Wave 11 verified CC-BY-4.0 nanopore data tables: (1) Gumińska et al. 2025 Nat Commun (Ninetails data layer ONLY — software/weights excluded, Dziembowski Lab, PMC11920217, Zenodo 13837855 cc-by-4.0, polya_ninetails2025_ivt_and_mrna1273_ccby4_v1.parquet SHA-256 prefix 21a6ef0991b662f8, 101,138 rows): IVT protocol alters the fraction of reads carrying >=1 non-A decoration (mutT7 2.98% vs WT T7 9.58% vs PAP+ATP 5.62% vs PAP+equal rNTPs 79.56%), and therapeutic mRNA-1273 tails remodel in MURINE bone-marrow-derived macrophages (BMDM) from 0h input (median 99.80 nt, 4.61% decorated reads, n=58,083) to 24h WT (115.24 nt, 13.72% decorated) vs AC mutant (86.79 nt, 3.96% decorated); AND (2) Fuhrmann et al. 2026 PLOS Pathogens (Depledge Lab, PMC13271517, polya_fuhrmann2026_plospath_human_tails_ccby4_v1.parquet SHA-256 prefix e70bc4d564ed02fa, 4336 rows): clean uninfected human baselines show median poly(A) 83.86 nt (NHDF), 95.52 nt (A549), and 100.55 nt (MeWo); in HCMV-infected NHDF (72 hpi), siCNOT1 knockdown elongates median human poly(A) from 93-104 nt (siCTRL) to 126-128 nt; S5 Table logs 1,560 non-A incorporation rate-ratio rows across 1,114 distinct transcript IDs. Kept strictly conditional_rule.

audit_history.reason: Wave 11 verified CC-BY-4.0 human & IVT poly(A) length/composition datasets; conservatively held at conditional_rule (descriptive/manufacturing dynamics, not directional expression slope).

rules.readout_name_exact: Innate-Immune Sensor & ISG qPCR CT Shift (m1Psi-mRNA vs Unmodified U-mRNA, Kuzmin 2024 Fig 1D)
rules.statement: In Kuzmin et al. 2024 Nat Commun (PMC11289437, PMID:39080316, CC-BY-4.0, m1psi_kuzmin2024_u_vs_m1psi_immunity_ccby4_v1.parquet SHA-256 prefix dae73ad46caca3d9, Fig 1D 495 qPCR rows across 34 genes), full m1Psi substitution blunts unmodified-U mRNA innate-immune sensor and ISG induction back toward mock baseline in human THP-1 monocytes (stable 18s/GAPDH controls: DDX58/RIG-I +5.19 Ct, IFIH1/MDA5 +4.33 Ct, IFNB +6.12 Ct, IFNL1 +6.32 Ct, IFIT1 +7.46 Ct, IFIT3 +6.72 Ct, MX1 +7.34 Ct, MX2 +6.03 Ct, ISG20 +6.31 Ct). Censoring & housekeeping caveats (A-W11): 80/495 raw Ct readings were 'Undetermined' (right-censored) and assigned 40.0 ONLY in the imputed summary column (e.g. THP-1 IFNL1 m1Psi & mock are censored at 40.0); in A549, m1Psi-minus-U housekeeping shifted -10.72 Ct (18S) and -7.67 Ct (GAPDH), prohibiting direct unnormalized cross-cell Ct comparisons. Single CC-BY-4.0 dataset -> kept strictly conditional_rule.

rules.readout_name_exact: saRNA In Vitro Antigen Expression (%) & NHP 0h-vs-24h Innate Cytokine Panel (Vijayan 2024 Nat Commun)
rules.statement: In Vijayan et al. 2024 Nat Commun (PMC11564874, PMID:39543172, CC-BY-4.0, sarna_vijayan2024_rsv_smarrt_ccby4_v1.parquet SHA-256 fe3d7176b786df3d, 1,881 rows), unmodified SMARRT.RSV.preF saRNA reaches near-saturating in vitro antigen expression at 6.25-25 ng across two independent batches (total RSV.F 86.65%->94.90%; surface 79.10%->92.85% vs 0.02-0.08% at 0 ng) and elicits NHP neutralizing immunity while triggering measurable 0h->24h innate cytokine responses (1,577 analyte readings). Supports tracking saRNA replication potency and innate reactogenicity on separate Pareto axes. Single CC-BY-4.0 dataset -> kept strictly conditional_rule.
